title: Oily Braised Saudi Arabian Lamb Wrap
description: A briny, silky, and cozy Saudi Arabian dish featuring tender lamb, served in a low-calorie friendly wrap.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the tomato paste, beef broth, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until it is tender and falls apart easily.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the wraps by slicing the lamb and serving it in the pita bread with pickled turnips.
